cohort: 513 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) admitted to Tangshan Central Hospital (Tangshan, China) between January 2019 and December 2022
finding: In pregnant women with GDM, dietary intervention combined with insulin aspart improved clinical outcomes, reduced nesfatin-1, CTRP12, and blood glucose levels, and reduced the incidence of adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to insulin aspart therapy alone.
mod_finding: The group receiving dietary intervention combined with insulin aspart had significantly fewer cesarean sections compared to the control group.
